title: Weekend at Bernie's
tagline: Bernie's throwing a party. He just doesn't know it.
about: Two junior employees pretend their dead boss is alive at his beach house for the weekend.
cue: Serve the cocktails when the guests turn up at Bernie's beach house.

    StartersHamptons clam dipChopped clams folded into cream cheese and sour cream, with potato chipsHow to make it1 tin chopped clams200g cream cheese100g sour cream1 lemon1 dash Worcestershire sauce1 bunch chives1 bag potato chipsDrain the clams, keeping a little juice.Fold the clams into the cream cheese and sour cream with lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and chopped chives.Serve with potato chips.Rumaki bacon wrapped water chestnutsWater chestnuts wrapped in bacon, glazed with soy, brown sugar and gingerHow to make it1 tin water chestnuts8 rashers of bacon2 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp brown sugar1 tsp grated gingerDrain the water chestnuts and wrap each in half a rasher of bacon.Brush with the soy, sugar and ginger.Bake at 200°C until sticky.Bernie's deck party devilled eggsPassed round the deck while nobody notices BernieHow to make it8 eggs3 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise1 tsp Dijon mustard1 tsp smoked paprika1 bunch chives2 tbsp crispy fried shallotsBoil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt.Pipe the filling back into the whites.Dust with paprika and top with chives and crispy shallots.MainsBernie's beach house clambakeClams, lobster tails, corn and potatoes steamed in white wine and garlic butterHow to make it600g new potatoes4 corn cobs250ml white wine3 garlic cloves80g butter1kg clams4 lobster tailsHalve the corn, crush the garlic and scrub the clams.Boil the potatoes in a big pot.Add the corn, wine, garlic and butter, then the clams and lobster tails. Cover and steam.Tip it all onto the table.Teriyaki sirloin with charred pineappleThe deck barbecueHow to make itAs written, serves 4Sirloin marinated in soy, garlic, ginger and pineapple juice, grilled medium-rare, with charred pineapple, coconut rice and a sticky teriyaki glaze.Mix 80ml soy, 80ml pineapple juice, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves and grated ginger.Marinate 4 sirloin steaks for 2 hours.Cook 300g jasmine rice with 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water.Grill the steaks on very high heat 3 minutes a side and rest 5 minutes.Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred.Boil the leftover marinade for 3 minutes until sticky and spoon over the sliced steak.SweetsPineapple upside-down cakeButtery sponge baked over caramelised pineapple rings and cherries, flipped outHow to make it185g butter80g brown sugar1 tin pineapple rings6 maraschino cherries125g caster sugar2 eggs175g self-raising flourMelt some of the butter with the brown sugar in a tin and lay pineapple rings with a cherry in each.Beat the remaining butter and caster sugar, add the eggs and fold in the flour.Spread over the fruit and bake at 175°C.Rest briefly, then flip out.DrinksLarry and Richard's mai taiTwo rums, orange liqueur, orgeat and lime over crushed iceHow to make it120ml white rum120ml dark rum60ml orange liqueur60ml orgeat syrup100ml lime juice1 bunch mintcrushed ice, to serveJuice the limes.Shake the rums, liqueur, orgeat and lime juice with ice, in batches.Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig.Planter's punchThe Hamptons crowd swears Bernie mixed this.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
